claims_and_limits: October 21 v0.163.2 is a binary distribution maintenance release updating Go and the certificate authority bundle, not the origin of Collector resilience capabilities.
The official guides describe queues, retry windows, persistent storage, component configuration and service pipeline enablement.
The counted outage/restart procedure is an editorial test proposal; the infographic is conceptual and does not report measured span loss.
